title: PeakPack for Mac - slot 3: cross-play with a friend, voice, microphone prompt (humans present)

machine.screen: ours for the slot; Joshua at the iMac for voice

steam_tests.note: tests-only prerelease (probes with the PEAK-style ticket call); verified against its SHA256SUMS

schedule_with: Joshua (at the iMac) and the pilot friend (own Windows PC, own Steam account, PeakPack synced to the same pack revision) for about 45 min after the setup gates

environment.PP_HUMAN_PRESENT: 1 for H-MIC and G-X1 only, once both people are ready

early_cu.instruction: Same as slot 1: Mac Steam console, download_depot 3527290 3527291, answer with path= and manifest=. See gates/G-B5.md CU-download.

gates.needs_human: only if Steam is not running and a sign-in window appears

gates.command: PP_HUMAN_PRESENT=1 bash testkit/run_gate.sh H-MIC --job-dir $JOB  (start in parallel with G-X1)
gates.needs_human: yes: only Joshua answers the macOS microphone prompt

gates.pass: room-code join both ways; Steam friends-list join both ways; voice both ways (built-in mic); companion lobby check clean; heli, glider, item tuner, scoutmaster consistent on both sides; no desync

notes: Without PP_HUMAN_PRESENT=1, run_slot.sh records H-MIC and G-X1 as needs-human (exit 3) with the printed instructions; run them by hand when both people are ready.

cleanup.after: Joshua may switch the microphone permission off again (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone)
